description: Søker etter klientnavn, organisasjonsnummer eller år i firmaet tilkoblingen gjelder. Uten søkeord listes firmaets aktive oppdrag. Hvert treff viser hvor mange forespørsler som venter på klienten og siden når, og lovfristene Revly utleder for revisjonsoppdrag. En frist uten grunnlag står som ukjent, aldri som en gjettet dato. Gir høyst åtte treff.

sok.description: Klientnavn, organisasjonsnummer eller fire-sifret oppdragsår. Utelat for å liste aktive oppdrag.

name: finn_oppdrag

outputSchema.description: Engagement search result for the connected firm.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches requested, from 1 to 8.

eldste_venter_siden.description: Sent date of the oldest request waiting for the client, as YYYY-MM-DD. Null when none is waiting.

beretning_dato.description: Date the audit report was issued, as YYYY-MM-DD. Null when not issued.

regnskapsaar_type.description: Fiscal year type of the client, for example avvikende.

lovfrist_grunnlag.description: Basis Revly derives the statutory deadlines from.

dager_igjen.description: Days left; negative once the date has passed. Null when the date is unknown.

dato.description: Deadline as YYYY-MM-DD. Null when Revly lacks the basis; ukjent_grunn says why. Never a guessed date.

oppfylt_dato.description: Date that met the deadline, when Revly has one.

oversittet.description: True only when the date has passed without the deadline being met, and Revly can observe that.

lovfrister.description: Statutory deadlines derived by Revly from lovfrist_grunnlag. Empty for engagements without statutory deadlines.

oppdrag_id.description: Engagement ID, as text. Pass it to the detail tools.

oppdragstype.description: Engagement type. Only audit engagements have statutory deadlines.

revly_url.description: Link to the engagement in Revly.

venter_paa_klient.description: Number of requests on this engagement that are waiting for the client (sent, not yet answered).

operation_id.description: Revly operation ID for this read, recorded in the access log.

status.description: matches, no_matches or truncated when more rows exist than the limit.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist than the limit.

title: Finn oppdrag i tilkoblet firma
